prompt_text: 请判断试样是否断裂（has_fracture），并给出断裂帧区间（fracture_between）、断裂类型（type）和断裂位置（location）。
system_prompt: 你是一位材料力学视频分析助手。请根据提供的拉伸试验视频，基于画面中的试样变化，判断试样的断裂信息。最后请输出JSON格式的回答。

has_fracture.description: 是否在视频中观察到试样断裂；无法判断时为 null

fracture_between.description: 断裂发生的两个相邻采样帧索引，例如 [2, 3]；未断裂或无法定位时为 null

type.description: 断裂类型或状态。合法取值包括 8 种断裂类（"韧性断裂"、"脆性断裂"、"界面脱粘"、"齐根断裂"、"爆炸性断裂"、"半脆半韧断裂"、"界面脱粘、齐根断裂"、"脆性断裂、齐根断裂"）、 "未断裂"、"未夹紧" 或 null。

notes: Raw protocol compliance and normalized output are recorded separately.
Ground-truth metadata is included as reference context for task-metric analysis.
Field metrics credit each valid normalized field independently; missing or invalid fields remain incorrect.
Joint success additionally requires the complete normalized output contract to be valid.
Interval accuracy is exact sampled-frame bracket accuracy where a target interval exists.
Time hit requires the ground-truth event time to fall inside the predicted sampled-frame time bracket.
Joint success uses exact interval agreement when available, otherwise time hit for timed positive source videos.
